text: I'm looking after my nephew, 2, temp 38.8. He's got little freckle-looking dots on his legs that weren't there this morning and they don't go away when I press a glass on them, I think, I did it twice. His nappy has been dry for over 12 hours too. His eczema's flared up and he's scratching it. He's awake and chatting and watching cartoons, no fits or shaking. I'm scared, not sure what to do
